## de45fc71c193

**Reproduced defect — validator/generator exclude a canonical-valid input.** The
third canonical input contains colors 8 and 9, four corner cells per color. The
generator's `self_check` rejects it because color 8 is treated as output-only and
then reports only one active input color. The supported canonical Racket rule
successfully maps the same input to the filled intersection of the two bounding
boxes. The exact input, output, hashes, and command are in
`checks/audit/de45fc71c193/input.json` and
`checks/audit/de45fc71c193/racket.json`; generator SHA is
`2f041639dc57ad47a5c4581aa23599526a1878ed79f881b23a1998c574338fe7` and
rule hash is `f9a51da365cc`.

**Possible shortcut.** In 300 default draws (100 each easy/medium/hard; seeds
`10000+i`, sample index `i`), zero inputs contained color 8 and all 300 used
exactly two diagonal cells per color. All three canonical pairs instead use four
bounding-box corners per color, and one valid canonical input uses 8 as an input
color. A learner can therefore fit generated data with either “8 is output-only”
or “each source box is encoded by exactly two points,” neither of which matches
the canonical domain. The retained rival that treats input 8 as output-only
returns an empty grid and differs from the authoritative output
(`checks/audit/de45fc71c193/rival_output_only_8.json`). Counts and validator
messages are in `checks/audit/probe.json`. No files for this audit target were
changed.
